# dsh-review-comments
English | 中文

A **file review comments** plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It lives in the right
sidebar: br

git status, comment on

a line or a line range, then hand the collected comments to the

model as a compact `path#line` ordered list.
> In the Harness UI the entry is the **File Review** guide card (中文：文件评审).
## Demo
## Scope

This plugin focuses on **comments**: read full file content, anchor a comment to a line or
a line ra

nge, then hand the collected comments to the model. Git changes are shown as
context marks, so brows
ing changes and writing comments stay out of each other's way.
## Features

- **Right-sidebar entry** — a guide card in the Harness right sidebar; no separate window,
no custom

panel chrome. The tab framework, theme tokens and locale are the harness's own.
- **Recursive fuzzy

search** — type any part of a name: `changesitems` finds
`changes_items.tsx`; separators and missin

g characters do not matter. Results are ranked
by match quality and grouped by folder. Skips `.git`/

`.svn`/`.hg`/`node_modules`.
- **Syntax highlighting** — grammar-based, powered by a vendored Prism.

js
1.30.0 (MIT, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): JavaScript/TypeScript/
JSX/TSX, JSON, CSS/SCSS/Less, HT

ML/XML/SVG/Vue, Markdown, Python, Shell, YAML, TOML, INI,
SQL, diff/patch, Go, Rust, Java; other suf

fixes fall back to plain text. Long files
(>5000 lines) render as plain text to stay responsive.
- *

*Git status** — added/untracked = green, modified/renamed = blue, deleted = red,
conflicted = amber,

both in the file tree (with A/M/D/R/U letters) and as per-line
vertical bars in the file view. A **

Changed only** switch lists just the project's
uncommitted files.
- **Line comments** — double-click

a line, or drag across lines to select a range, then
type in the composer that opens below the sele

ction. `Enter` turns it into an inline
card; `Shift+Enter` adds a newline; `Esc` cancels.
- **Jump b

etween comments** — the file header shows the current position (`2/7`) with
previous/next buttons; `

Ctrl/Cmd+Up/Down`, `Ctrl/Cmd+P/N` and `Ctrl/Cmd+wheel` jump too.
The tree shows a right-aligned comm

ent count per file and, for folders, the aggregate of
everything below them (rendered as a bold coun

t tag on the theme accent colour, like the
composer's send button); the browser footer always shows

the workspace total. The browser
header has a labelled **Delete all comments** button (the footer ca

rries the same action as
a compact icon button), while the file header deletes only that file's comm

ents and its
subtitle shows that file's count. Search results and the changed-files list carry the s

ame
count tags.
- **Send comments to the model** — `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` in the comment box or the panel'

- **Send comments to the model** — `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` in the comment box or the panel's send
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- A DeepSeek Harness profile whose Web UI includes the right sidebar
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-si

debar-right` — part of the default web bundle). Tested with
DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` on macOS;

other desktop/web platforms should work.
- Node.js ≥ 20 only if you build from source.
- Optional: `
git` on `PATH`. Without it the plugin still runs; git status stays off.
## Install
### From the Plugin Manager (recommended)

1. Open **Settings → Plugins**.
2. Install from this repository: paste `https://github.com/HusuSama/

dsh-review-comments`
(the manager supports GitHub sources) or pick a local checkout directory.
3. Th
e bundle is selected automatically — the browser half hot-loads into the open page.
### What the model receives

A single user message with an intro line and one ordered-list item per comment — absolute
path plus

`#startLine` (or `#startLine:endLine`), then the comment text. No source excerpts:
the model can rea
d the file at those lines itself.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The message follows the active UI language (Chinese above); items are ordered by path and
start line
, and multi-line comment text keeps its list indentation.
## How it works

- `index.js` — host half. Uses the harness `sessions` + `workingDirectory` services to find
each liv

e session's project, then `git rev-parse/status/diff` through `child_process`, and
writes `<status-d

ir>/<sessionId>.json` (atomic, only when changed).
- `client.js` (generated by `build.mjs`) — browse

r half. Registers a right-sidebar tab type
(`ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register`) plus its body in the `s

idebar.right.pane.tab` slot, reads
workspace files through `remote.workspaceFiles`, and polls the st

atus file above.
- Sending reuses the composer's own `inputActions.setDraft()/submit()`, i.e. the sa

me path as
pressing Enter in the chat box. An invisible bridge above the composer appends the pendin

g
comments to an ordinary send (your text, blank line, then the list). Nothing is written to
the ses

sion log by the plugin itself.
- Everything visual uses `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens (`link`, `bg-do

cument-selection`,
`interactive-bg-hover-accent`, `elevation-panel`, …), so light/dark and themes co

tion`,
`interactive-bg-hover-accent`, `elevation-panel`, …), so light/dark and themes come for free.
## Limitations

- Text files only. Binary/undecodable files show “not a text file” instead of a preview
(images, PDF

s and Office documents are out of scope).
- Git status covers live sessions' working directories; re

positories are detected with
`git rev-parse`; non-repositories show the feature disabled.
- Comments

are anchored to line numbers as displayed when they were written. Editing or
reloading a different

version of the file does not move existing cards.
- Files are read page by page up to 20,000 lines;

highlighting is skipped above 5,000 lines.
- Search and git payloads are bounded as described above.
